reason: The flora says the stamens are longer than the petals. The annotation (stamen, increased length, compared with petal) says the same.
'Subleathery' means roughly leathery, so 'coriaceous, approximately' fits. The flora says this of the leaflet blades, but this is a leaf, so the bearer 'leaf' is acceptable.

fix: 'subentire' and 'entire' describe a leaf or bract margin. They should map to PATO 'entire' (entire margin), not 'unstructured'.
reason: The probract margin is almost entire. 'Unstructured' is a different quality.

fix: In 'X to Y at the base', the trailing 'at the base' should move the bearer to the base of the blade.
reason: Cuneate to narrowly rounded describes the base of the blade, not the shape of the whole blade.
Paleae are receptacle bracts. 'Bract, shape, lanceolate to oblong' matches the text.
Young shoots are pubescent. The 'young' context slot is filled.
The pods (fruit) are not stipitate. The negation and its scope are right.

fix: 'pedicel with ovary N mm long' (common in orchids) is one measurement of the combined unit. It should be recorded with a whole slot, not as the length of the pedicel alone.
reason: The 9–17 mm covers pedicel plus ovary. Pedicel alone is shorter.

target: ovate-elliptic (shape between ovate and elliptic), or ovate + elliptic as a continuum
fix: A hyphenated shape compound such as 'ovate-elliptic' should not be cut down to its last word.
reason: The spikelets are ovate-elliptic. Plain 'elliptic' drops the 'ovate' part.

fix: 'not seen', 'unknown' and 'not known' mean nobody has observed the part. They do not mean the part is absent and should not be read as negation.
reason: The flora says the achenes have not been observed, not that the plant lacks them.
Plant height up to about 3.8 m, as the flora says. 'tal' is a typo for 'tall'.

target: position: lateral segments of the female perigone; stage/state: often much reduced
fix: When '... les latéraux ... sans appendices' follows a statement about the median segment, the position slot (lateral) must be carried over.
reason: The median tepal of the female flower is appendiculate. Only the lateral, reduced tepals lack appendages, so 'tepals not appendiculate' without the position contradicts the source.

target: leaf lamina abaxial epidermis (PO_0000049); puberulent applies to the veins
fix: In 'abaxial surface ..., glabrous or veins puberulent', the surface named earlier in the clause must become the bearer, and 'veins' must narrow the second option.
reason: The adaxial surface is described separately (glabrous, veins strigillose). This statement is only about the abaxial surface, and puberulent only about its veins.

fix: The bearer of a comparison is the part named in the subject ('filaments'). It should not be widened to the parent organ.
reason: The flora compares the filaments with the sepals.
The petal apex is obtuse.
The drupe is pinkish, later turning purplish-black. 'Pink, approximately' holds as the main colour; a stage slot (before maturity) would make it more precise.
Blade width 2.8–10.9 mm with a maximum of 17.2 mm, as the flora says.

fix: Lobes counted on a corolla or limb are not leaf lamina lobes. When the container is the corolla, use the generic phyllome lamina lobe.
reason: The corolla limb is 5-lobed. These are corolla lobes, not leaf lobes.

fix: The 'stem-leaves' and 'basal leaves' prefixes must fill the position slot.
reason: Only the stem-leaves are linear or narrowly elliptic. The basal leaves are described differently, so 'leaf' without the position overstates the claim.

fix: 'Capitula ± dense' right after a description of the synflorescence describes how the heads are packed in it. A head with only 3–5 florets cannot be dense in itself.
reason: With 3–5 florets per head, 'dense' must refer to how densely the capitula are arranged.
The bracteoles are absent. A separate annotation should cover the bracts.

target: state: only in the seedless forms (cultivated forms)
fix: 'dans les formes dépourvues de graines' names a variant within the taxon. It is not a statement that the whole taxon lacks seeds.
reason: Only some forms of breadfruit are seedless. The sentence is about the fruit surface of those forms.
The leaf blade is folded or flat.
The stamens are shorter than the petals.

target: Sphagnum capitulum (the dense head of branches at the stem apex); no PO class, not an inflorescence
fix: In mosses, especially Sphagnum, 'capitulum' is a head of branches, not a flower head. It must not be mapped to 'capitulum inflorescence'.
reason: Sphagnum has no inflorescences.
The underside of the blade is densely tomentose.

target: place: distal part of the fruit (and the ovary); hirsutulous (minutely hirsute)
fix: Place adverbs such as 'distally', 'basally' and 'apically' must fill the place slot.
reason: Only the distal part of the capsule is hirsutulous. Also, 'hirsutulous' is a diminutive form of 'hirsute'.

target: scabrous to smooth (PATO_0000701), continuum; bearer the upper surface
fix: The 'X to Y' range must keep both ends, even after a '±'.
reason: The flora gives a range from slightly scabrous to smooth. Recording only 'scabrous' changes the meaning. The statement is also about the upper surface only.

target: phyllome lamina lobe (PO_0025514) of the labellum (lip)
fix: 'lateral lobes' inside a description of an orchid lip are lip lobes, not leaf lamina lobes.
reason: The erect or ascending lobes are the lateral lobes of the lip.
The petals are small.
